instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check, each time a buyer opens a paid file link, that they still hold access, and say which sealed bytes to stream", and give it token (The last part of the link the buyer opened); subject (The account the door verified from the presenting session, named the way your access rules name a buyer).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:open-a-paid-file-for-a-buyer and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: For a link's token and the account presenting it: refuses a malformed or expired token, then checks the file's paid-file record against what the presenter holds now, so a refund or an ended subscription stops the very next open and a link passed to someone else does not open.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: paid-file (records:read); payment-event (records:list); record:commercial-offer (records:list); access-grant (records:list); access-effect-rule (records:list); effect-lifecycle (records:list).
